note: What a server sends to take the match off hold. The header names a champion: that of the player who resumed the match.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the player who resumed the match, announced in chat in their side's colour where their champion is known; 4294967295 announces no one.

bits.name: afterCountdown
bits.note: Set where the match starts again after a countdown rather than at once.

revisions.note: The header has no effect. Resuming after the countdown, it keeps input locked and the pause panel open until a countdown of its own ends; resuming at once, it unlocks input and closes the panel.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the client that lifted the hold.
